name: Le Bunny

features.name: Golden Squares
features.description: Winning positions reveal coins, baskets, clovers or Jackpot Eggs.

features.name: Super Cascades
features.description: Remove every symbol of the winning type.

review:
Smokey dressed as the Easter bunny. Wins leave Golden Squares behind, and a Rainbow turns them into bronze, silver or gold coins, basket collectors, green or gold clovers, or Jackpot Eggs.

Super Cascades clear every winning symbol type so new ones drop in – so one spin can build several squares before the rainbow arrives. That makes it play a little differently from the other Le games. Three bonuses boost the reveals. 20,000x max.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
